headlines.title: 香港证监会：对耀才证券作出谴责并处以罚款280万港元
headlines.summary: 香港证监会对耀才证券国际（香港）有限公司（耀才）作出谴责并处以罚款280万港元，原因是该公司没有实施充足而有效的内部监控程序，以监察和侦测由其客户进行的清洗交易。香港证监会的调查发现，于2023年11月1日至2025年9月13日期间，由于耀才的内部监控措施不足，导致615个客户帐户执行了1,021对涉及736只股票及权证的清洗交易。香港证监会亦发现，由于耀才在2024年3月前主要依赖交易后监察及人手审查来识别可疑交易活动，客户因而得以在被侦测前进行清洗交易。（香港证监会网站）

headlines.title_en: Hong Kong SFC reprimands and fines Bright Smart Securities HK$2.8 million
headlines.summary_en: Hong Kong's Securities and Futures Commission (SFC) has reprimanded and fined Bright Smart Securities International (Hong Kong) Limited (Bright Smart) HK$2.8 million for failing to implement adequate and effective internal controls to monitor and detect wash trading conducted by its clients. An SFC investigation found that between November 1, 2023, and September 13, 2025, due to inadequate internal controls at Bright Smart, 615 client accounts executed 1,021 pairs of wash trades involving 736 stocks and warrants. The SFC also found that because Bright Smart relied primarily on post-trade monitoring and manual review to identify suspicious trading activity before March 2024, clients were able to conduct wash trades before detection. (SFC website)

headlines.title: 商务部新闻发言人就美发布“强迫劳动”301调查最终措施答记者问
headlines.summary: 商务部新闻发言人就美发布“强迫劳动”301调查最终措施答记者问。 问：美东时间7月23日，美国贸易代表办公室依据“未禁止进口强迫劳动产品”301调查结果，发布最终措施，对包括中国在内的60个经济体加征301关税，对华加征12.5%的301关税。请问中方对此有何回应？ 答：我们注意到有关情况。中方一贯反对强迫劳动，建立了完善的劳动法律法规体系，坚决防范和打击强迫劳动行为。反观美方，不仅仍未批准加入《1930年强迫劳动公约》，还长期操弄“强迫劳动”议题，此次又以“强迫劳动”为由发起301调查并加征单边关税，是典型的单边主义、保护主义行为，中方对此坚决反对。

headlines.title_en: Ministry of Commerce spokesperson responds to US release of final 'forced labor' Section 301 investigation measures
headlines.summary_en: Ministry of Commerce spokesperson answers reporter's questions on US release of final measures in 'Forced Labor' Section 301 investigation. Q: On July 23 Eastern Time, the US Trade Representative's Office, based on the results of the Section 301 investigation into 'Products Not Banned for Import Due to Forced Labor', released final measures imposing Section 301 tariffs on 60 economies, including China, with an additional 12.5% tariff on China. What is China's response? A: We have taken note of the situation. China consistently opposes forced labor, has established a comprehensive labor legal framework, and resolutely prevents and combats forced labor practices. In contrast, the US has not only failed to ratify the 1930 Forced Labour Convention but has also long manipulated the 'forced labor' issue. This latest initiation of a Section 301 investigation and imposition of unilateral tariffs under the pretext of 'forced labor' is typical unilateralism and protectionism, which China firmly opposes.

headlines.title: 美宣称拟对中国人工智能企业开展调查并实施制裁 商务部回应
headlines.summary: 问：近日，美国一些高级官员公开表示将针对中国人工智能企业所谓“蒸馏”美前沿模型开展调查，并可能以“窃取美国知识产权”等为由制裁中国企业。请问中方对此有何评论？ 答：我们注意到有关情况。中方一贯反对美方将科技经贸问题政治化、工具化，以各种莫须有的理由污名化中国企业并实施制裁。美方罔顾有关中国企业人工智能模型与美前沿模型发布时间非常接近、中国部分模型能力已处于领先地位等事实，给中国企业扣上所谓依靠“蒸馏”“窃取美国知识产权”等帽子，还威胁进行打压制裁。这些做法缺乏事实依据，没有法理支撑，在实践上搞双重标准，属于典型的人工智能霸权主义行径。

headlines.title_en: US claims to investigate and sanction Chinese AI companies; Ministry of Commerce responds
headlines.summary_en: Q: Recently, some senior US officials have publicly stated they will investigate Chinese AI companies for the alleged 'distillation' of US frontier models, and may sanction Chinese companies on grounds like 'stealing US intellectual property'. What is China's comment? A: We have taken note of the situation. China consistently opposes the US politicizing and instrumentalizing technological and economic issues, stigmatizing Chinese companies with various baseless pretexts, and imposing sanctions. The US ignores facts such as the very close release times of some Chinese AI models compared to US frontier models and the leading capabilities of some Chinese models, labeling Chinese companies as relying on 'distillation' or 'stealing US IP' and threatening suppression and sanctions. These actions lack factual basis, have no legal support, apply double standards in practice, and are typical acts of AI hegemonism.

headlines.title: 蓝盾光电：筹划发行股份及支付现金购买资产并募集配套资金事项，股票停牌
headlines.summary: 金十数据7月27日讯，蓝盾光电公告，公司正筹划发行股份及支付现金购买资产并募集配套资金事项，因有关事项尚存在不确定性，为了维护投资者利益，避免对公司证券交易造成重大影响，根据深圳证券交易所的相关规定，经公司申请，公司股票自2026年7月27日开市起停牌。公司预计在不超过10个交易日的时间内披露本次交易方案，即在2026年8月10日前按照《公开发行证券的公司信息披露内容与格式准则第26号——上市公司重大资产重组》的要求披露相关信息。

headlines.summary_en: Jin Shi data July 27: Landun Photoelectronics announces it is planning to issue shares and pay cash to acquire assets and raise matching funds. As the matter involves uncertainty, to protect investor interests and avoid major impact on its securities trading, and in accordance with relevant Shenzhen Stock Exchange regulations, the company applied for and its shares will be suspended from trading starting from the opening on July 27, 2026. The company expects to disclose the transaction plan within no more than 10 trading days, i.e., by August 10, 2026, disclosing relevant information in accordance with CSRC disclosure standards.

headlines.summary_en: China Association for Public Companies releases June statistical monthly report. Data shows as of June 30, 2026, domestic stock markets had 5,535 listed companies: 2,314 on the Shanghai Stock Exchange, 2,898 on the Shenzhen Stock Exchange, and 323 on the Beijing Stock Exchange. By share type, 5,263 companies issued only A-shares, 265 issued multi-share types like A+H or A+B, and 7 issued only B-shares.
